gloss: to freeze, to be numb with cold

definitions.gloss: to freeze, to be numb with cold, to be chilled to the bone
definitions.explanation: To become extremely cold to the point of numbness or immobility. Used for body parts or the whole body experiencing intense cold.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}さで{体|からだ}が{凍|こご}えそうだ。
{凍|こご}えるような{冬|ふゆ}の{朝|あさ}に、{彼|かれ}は{早起|はやお}きして{走|はし}りに{出|で}た。
examples.english: On a freezing winter morning, he woke up early and went out for a run.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). Takes が particle: {手|て}が{凍|こご}える.

CONJUGATION: Ichidan verb: {凍|こご}えない, {凍|こご}えます, {凍|こご}えて, {凍|こご}えれば.

ASPECT: {凍|こご}えている indicates the resulting state of being frozen/numb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手|て}/{足|あし}/{指|ゆび}が{凍|こご}える (hands/feet/fingers freeze)
- {凍|こご}えそう (about to freeze)
- {凍|こご}えるような{寒|さむ}さ/{風|かぜ} (freezing cold/wind)
- {凍|こご}え{死|じ}ぬ (to freeze to death)

RELATED WORDS:
- {凍|こお}る (to freeze - for objects/water becoming ice)
- かじかむ (to be numb with cold - more casual)
- {冷|ひ}える (to become cold - milder than {凍|こご}える)
